notes: New 'Biggest folders' tab shows where your space goes.
patch_notes: There is a new 'Biggest folders' tab next to 'Files to clean' and 'System space'. After a scan it lists the largest folders inside the folders you scanned, biggest first, each with its size, file count and a bar showing how it compares to the largest one. Sizes count every file in each folder, not just the junk the scan found, so you can see where your space really goes before cleaning. The tab is read-only and has an Open button per folder; nothing is deleted from it. The breakdown runs in parallel with the scan, so the scan itself takes no longer.
